decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The basement rooms have substandard natural light and do not qaulify as habitable rooms.  The basement is only suitable for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as 75 Airedale Avenue, W4 2NN.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 7am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 2pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Alterations to existing basement to create playroom and study formation of a lightwell to front elevation of existing dwellinghouse.
